production_on_stage.title: Coordinate Carnival
production_on_stage.claim_boundary: No public or Vercel deployment was attempted or claimed.

verified_behaviors: Applies repertory content by textContent and attribute mutation without HTML parsing.
Does not replace the repertory root or an already-focused descendant.
Suspends hidden productions in place and retains their existing content.
Fails closed when network, persistence, autoplay, or gesture-free audio behavior is requested.
Returns a bounded target_missing result when the application mount is absent.

verification.environment: isolated Node runtime with a deterministic DOM-compatible test double

rollback.method: Create ordinary revert commits for the additive source, test, evidence, and queue-update commits.
